title: plugin-auth test: `organization-access-policy.test.ts` sets a session exactly 60 minutes old against a one-hour limit and expects `admitted`, so it goes red whenever a millisecond passes (main red on 56baf78e)
body:
triage#1 · os-zhuang · session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U

Filing gate: ① a defect with a named location and a measured red: push `CI` on `main` `56baf78e` (run 42384924042, `Test Core (7/8)`). ⛔ Not a claim.

## 维护者速读

主线 CI 在 `56baf78e` 上红了一次，红在 plugin-auth 的一个测试上。测试把会话的创建时间设成「正好 60 分钟前」，再断言「1 小时上限还没到」；只要从设时间到判断之间过去哪怕 1 毫秒，会话就超过 60 分钟、被判定结束，测试就红。这是测试写在时间边界上，不是产品回归：产品按上限判定是对的。

## Measured

- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/organization-access-policy.test.ts` L398: the fixture row gets `created_at: new Date(Date.now() - 60 * MIN)`. L420–422: `session_absolute_max_hours: 1`, comment "60 minutes old against a one-hour limit: not over yet", `expect(...judgeSessionSwitch('s1', ORG_A)).toBe('admitted')`.
- Run 42384924042, `Test Core (7/8)`: `AssertionError: expected 'ended' to be 'admitted'` at L422. Failed 1 of 4,168 plugin-auth tests.
- The test arrived with `b5696b4967` (PR #31013, #30922, landed 2026-11-07).

## Expected

- The "not over yet" case sits clearly inside the limit (for example 59 minutes, or a frozen clock with `vi.useFakeTimers` / an injected `now`), and the "over" case clearly outside it (61 minutes stays). The assertion keeps proving that the absolute limit is judged at the switch.
- Re-read the file's other `minutesAgo` fixtures (L336–346) for the same boundary pattern.

## Acceptance

- The test passes with an artificial delay between fixture and judgment (a fake-timer advance of a few seconds, staying under the limit).

Suggested grade: p1 (a main red, and 「平台测试清单反复变红，肯定要修啊」). Lane `domain:server`.
